gloss: society of commerce and industry; local business association

definitions.gloss: society of commerce and industry; local business association
definitions.explanation: A statutory local organization of small businesses in a town or village. It offers management advice, bookkeeping help, and loan support to member shops and workshops, and often runs local events.

examples.japanese: {商工会|しょうこうかい}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I joined the society of commerce and industry.

examples.japanese: {町|まち}の{商工会|しょうこうかい}が{夏|なつ}の{祭|まつ}りを{主催|しゅさい}している。
examples.english: The town's society of commerce and industry organizes the summer festival.

examples.japanese: {商工会|しょうこうかい}の{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}で、{開業|かいぎょう}{資金|しきん}の{借|か}り{方|かた}について{助言|じょげん}をもらった。
examples.english: At the business association's advice desk, I got guidance on how to borrow start-up funds.

notes:
Formed from {商工|しょうこう} (commerce and industry) + {会|かい} (association). Each town or village typically has one, and membership is common for small local businesses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商工会|しょうこうかい}に{入|はい}る: to join the association
- {商工会|しょうこうかい}の{会員|かいいん}: a member of the association
- {商工会|しょうこうかい}{青年部|せいねんぶ}: the association's young members' division
- {商工会|しょうこうかい}が{主催|しゅさい}する: to be hosted by the association

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {商工会議所|しょうこうかいぎしょ}: chamber of commerce and industry — the equivalent body in cities, generally larger
- {組合|くみあい}: union; cooperative — a broader word for any member association
